title: Time-constrained Dynamic Mechanisms for College Admissions
abstract: arXiv:2207.12179v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Recent literature shows that dynamic matching mechanisms may outperform their static counterparts. The college admissions procedure used in Inner Mongolia motivates an underexplored design dimension of such mechanisms: the time constraint that students face. We study the time-constrained dynamic mechanism (TCDM) theoretically and show that, under straightforward behavior, it can generate unstable outcomes and, in some cases, outcomes that are Pareto dominated by those produced by the student-proposing deferred acceptance mechanism (DA). We also compare students' assignment probabilities under TCDM and DA. Under this behavior, TCDM gives each student a weakly higher probability of receiving her first choice. Under universal acceptability and sufficient aggregate capacity, it also gives each student a weakly higher probability of remaining unassigned and a weakly lower probability of receiving a non-first-choice college.

translated_title: 时间受限的大学录取动态机制
translated_abstract: arXiv:2207.12179v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：近期文献表明，动态匹配机制可能优于静态对应机制。内蒙古使用的大学录取程序启发了此类机制中一个未被充分探索的设计维度：学生面临的时间限制。我们从理论上研究了时间受限动态机制（TCDM），并表明，在直接行为下，它可能产生不稳定的结果，在某些情况下，其产生的结果被学生提议的递延接受机制（DA）所产生的结果帕累托支配。我们还比较了学生在TCDM和DA下的分配概率。在这种行为下，TCDM给每个学生一个弱更高的概率获得其第一选择。在普遍可接受性和足够的总体容量下，它还给每个学生一个弱更高的概率保持未分配状态，以及一个弱更低的概率获得非首选大学。
tldr: 本研究首次从理论上分析了时间受限动态机制（TCDM）在大学录取中的应用，发现其可能导致不稳定结果，但在学生偏好和容量条件下，能提高学生获得首选大学的概率。
en_tdlr: This study theoretically analyzes the time-constrained dynamic mechanism (TCDM) in college admissions, revealing potential instability but also increased chances for students to receive their first choice under certain conditions.
